# Embedding

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Embedding`](gmeow-Embedding.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Embedding>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)

A vector representation of an information object (usually a core [`gmeow:Chunk`](gmeow-Chunk.md)), produced by an embedding model — the genuine vocabulary gap in the semantic-web stack: model, dimensionality, and metric have no agreed RDF representation, so the refusal is recorded in the alignment trailer rather than papered over. The vector payload stays OUTSIDE the graph ([`gmeow:vectorRef`](../properties/gmeow-vectorRef.md), P12); the graph carries the provenance that makes it auditable.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Embedding`](gmeow-Embedding.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

    gmeow:distanceMetric gmeow:distanceMetricCosine ;
    gmeow:vectorRef "s3://lillith/vectors/chunk-7"^^xsd:anyURI ;
